notes.title: Re-armored update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208590/014f26d88a9ce6eab7373e45f9200a4780b97d84.png[/img]

We have completed work on the first [b]major update [/b]of the game. There are a lot of changes, starting from the basic mechanics and ending with the graphic component. Current game version: 1.1.

[b]List of changes:[/b]

1) Absolutely new system of stations and their generations.
2) The ability to walk through the stations.
3) New character models.
4) Absolutely new inventory system.
5) Modified mechanics of transportation of goods. (In the future will be finalized)
6) Weapons and combat system also completely changed.
7) Division of locations into zones with their own levels and opponents.
8) The window of death with the final score.
9) New simplified menu.
10) New simplified interfaces. They have become more responsive and informative.
11) Changed the system used items.
12) Ability to customize the level of difficulty.
13) Modified mechanics of staff orders. Now you need to click on the crew member and drag his icon to the desired location.
14) Removed a lot of unnecessary and non-working content.

[u]This is only a small part of the changes. We hope you like it.[/u]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208590/2e9467fe4e61a07125b059914d7cf26afd8103d9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208590/6cd3ed4da9515367dec7aaccc4dcbd2dfb1e7dbe.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Version 1.063 (Bugfixes + manual)
notes.notes:
I'm beginning to quietly patch holes in the armored train. I hate to leave negative impressions from the game. A certain amount of time will be spent correcting old mistakes, and if everything goes well, then new content will appear later.

[b]New:[/b]
1) Removed a strange menu with the choice of the train. Now the whole setup is done in the main menu.
2) Added button "manual". A small description of all the basic mechanics.
3) Changed the background and name of the game in the main menu.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
1) Some of the Russian letters in the English version are reduced.
2) The choice of the train works more correctly, although it requires an additional balance.

Thank you for watching the updates,
[b]Nikolay[/b]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208590/2e9467fe4e61a07125b059914d7cf26afd8103d9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208590/6cd3ed4da9515367dec7aaccc4dcbd2dfb1e7dbe.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Release of the game
notes.notes:
Today, after a long time, the game will finally see the light. The path of development was long and complicated, many difficulties were overcome. I just want to say that not all ideas are implemented, but later they will necessarily be added to the game. Absolutely free. I hope that everyone will be able to find something in the game, something interesting. I will listen to any comments and suggestions, because the development of the game does not stop after the release :)

Norska Studios
Nikolai
